description: Key prefixes approved for publication to the public R2 bucket (boundaries-data, served at https://data.civgraph.net). Writing an object under one of these prefixes publishes it to the open internet immediately. scripts/lib/r2-publication-gate.mjs refuses uploads to any key not covered here.
howToAddAPrefix: Add an entry with prefix, rationale, and evidence, then have it reviewed in the same commit as the upload that needs it. Do not add a prefix speculatively.
seedNote: Seeded 2026-08-05 from prefixes ALREADY serving publicly. These entries record observed production state; they are not a retrospective grant of approval. Rights reviewed 2026-08-05: every census prefix is Crown copyright under Open Government Licence v3.0 per the agent/ READMEs cited below, corroborated by the 'censusNisraOgl' rights code already used in approved-publication-sources.json.

prefixes.rationale: Canonical store for boundary geometry (FGB + compression variants) and per-map JSON indexes. The repo deliberately does not track these.
prefixes.evidence: .gitignore:158 'All FGBs in data/maps/ - R2 (data.civgraph.net) is the canonical source'; functions/data/maps/[[path]].js serves this prefix; verified live 2026-08-05 via preflight-data-migration.mjs
prefixes.rights: per-source; recorded on the individual Browse source records

prefixes.rationale: Feature thumbnail images served on Browse cards. Published by the existing sync:thumbnails npm script.
prefixes.evidence: package.json sync:thumbnails runs upload-tile-pyramid-s3.mjs against this prefix; also scripts/upload-feature-thumbnails-r2.mjs and the deploy:feature-thumbnails:r2 script
prefixes.rights: derived renderings of the underlying map sources; inherit their per-source terms

prefixes.rationale: Tailte Eireann National Land Cover 2018, CC BY 4.0 (verified from the ArcGIS item licenseInfo; data.gov.ie records no licence at all). Mirrored because the 48.5 GB GeoPackage could not complete an Internet Archive upload -- a single 5.5-hour stream was reset with nothing to resume. R2 multipart is resumable.
prefixes.evidence: archive.org/details/civgraph-tailte-national-land-cover-2018 holds the FileGDB original; this is the GeoPackage form of the same layer (NATIONAL_LAND_COVER_MAP_ITM, 10,114,816 features, EPSG:2157, verified identical with ogrinfo).

prefixes.rationale: Houses of the Oireachtas full text: 26,415 Akoma Ntoso debate transcripts and 13,918 bill/act PDFs, harvested from data.oireachtas.ie. Open data. Mirrored because the tree is currently single-copy on an exFAT volume with no journaling, and because the API only ever returns pointers to these documents.
prefixes.evidence: scripts/harvest-oireachtas-fulltext.mjs; completeness proven from disk (advertised 13,919 bill documents, 13,918 held -- the one exception, Maternity Protection (Amendment) Bill 2003 ver_b, is zero bytes at source with Content-Length: 0).

prefixes.rationale: Semantic graph shards (entities, statements, Browse mappings). Pure build output of scripts/graph/build-semantic-graph.mjs, regenerated from the catalogue, data/browse and the election data. Moving it to R2 does not change its exposure: it is not listed in .cfignore, so Cloudflare Pages already serves this whole tree publicly today.
prefixes.evidence: .cfignore does not exclude data/graph (census and timeline-transitions are excluded, this is not); functions/data/graph/[[path]].js serves this prefix and falls through to the static copy on a miss; 4,604 files / 1.91 GB currently tracked in git and deployed.
prefixes.rights: Derived work. Carries no source data of its own -- it is an index over records whose terms are recorded per source in data/database/maps.json and sources.json, and it inherits those terms.

prefixes.rationale: Scanned Dublin City Council development-plan sheets (1991 and 1993) and two page extracts, cited as primary evidence by the dublin-electoral-counties-1985 layer. This entry documents an EXISTING publication rather than authorising a new one: all 12 objects are already in the bucket, and every reference to them in the catalogue is an absolute https://data.civgraph.net/ URL, so R2 is already the address the site hands out.
prefixes.evidence: All 12 files verified present on data.civgraph.net with byte-exact Content-Length against the local copies (2026-08-12). 64 references across data/database/maps.json, render/metadata/maps-test.json, data/browse/maps.json and data/browse/details/source-shards/sources-183.json -- all 64 absolute to data.civgraph.net, zero relative. No Function is needed for this prefix.
prefixes.rights: Dublin City Council development plan material, cited as source evidence for a published boundary layer; terms recorded against the layer in data/database/maps.json.

prefixes.rationale: Browse indexes and per-record detail pages: the data behind browse/browse.js. Not excluded by .cfignore, so Cloudflare Pages already serves this entire tree publicly at civgraph.net/data/browse/ -- moving it to R2 changes the host, not the exposure. Mostly build output of scripts/build-browse-indexes.mjs; see the evidence note for the one file that is not. Subsumes the former data/browse/map-features/ entry: per-map feature attribute pages, generated and never tracked, already fetched directly from R2 by browse/browse.js.
prefixes.evidence: civgraph.net/data/browse/index.json, persons.json and source-index-shards/sources-000.json all return 200 from Pages today. 2,386 files / 351 MB tracked. Regeneration test on 2026-08-12 (directory moved aside, builder re-run from clean): 2,278 of 2,386 files reproduced. The 107 map details not reproduced are stale -- 98 are hidden:true in the catalogue and correctly excluded, 9 are the retired eds-YYYY-province naming set. proni-roots.json (1.39 MB) is the exception: NOTHING in scripts/ generates it, browse/browse.js fetches it with a silent .catch(() => null), so it is source material and must not be treated as regenerable. Former map-features evidence retained: browse/browse.js:169 MAP_FEATURES_BASE = https://data.civgraph.net/data/browse/map-features; .gitignore excludes data/browse/map-features/, so that subtree is generated-only and was never in git.
prefixes.rights: Derived indexes over records already published on the site. Carries no source data of its own; per-source terms are recorded in data/database/maps.json and sources.json and are inherited.

prefixes.rationale: Census sources, cleaned derivatives and OCR text for the all-Ireland census series. Approved for publication by the site owner on 2026-08-12. Subsumes the previously separate entries for data/census/2001-bulk/, data/census/2001-cleaned/, data/census/2011-bulk/, data/census/2011-cleaned/, data/census/nisra-ftb/, which were narrower prefixes of this same tree.
prefixes.evidence: Provenance is CSO/NISRA plus Internet Archive mirrors, harvested by scripts/census/scrape-cso-historical-reports.mjs and scripts/census/recover-cso-failed-links-wayback.mjs, with data/census/source-inventory/cso-historical-reports-ia-manifest.json and census-source-archives.json recording the mirrors. 4,980 files / 317 MB tracked.
prefixes.rights: Irish and Northern Irish official statistics. CSO material is published under CC BY 4.0; NISRA material under OGL. Derived and OCR products inherit those terms.

prefixes.rationale: Full territorial-transition sidecars for the ward chain -- the source QA artefacts the runtime overlays in data/timeline-transition-overlays/ are filtered from. Approved for publication 2026-08-12.
prefixes.evidence: Generated by scripts/build_all_timeline_transition_sidecars.py from data/maps, so wholly derived from boundary geometry already published on the site. 6 files / 153 MB tracked (4 geojson plus manifest and README); the rest of the directory has been gitignored since data/timeline-transitions/*.geojson was added to .gitignore.
prefixes.rights: Derived work over the site's own boundary layers; inherits their per-source terms as recorded in data/database/maps.json.
